title: Licence
subtitle: Service status for this customer.
warning: The licence is close to expiry, or the system is already read-only. Contact the provider before it blocks.
note: Maintenance data lives in the customer's own database. The licence enables the system that exploits it; it does not encrypt that data.

usage.title: Plan usage
usage.hint: Machines that are not retired count. At the ceiling, adding machines is blocked; readings never are.

renewal.title: Renew licence
renewal.hint: Each paid quarter is a new licence. If this server has no internet access, request it with the request code and upload the .lic file we send you.
renewal.requestHint: Email it to Industrie Ampel or photograph the QR code. It holds only what you see: no maintenance data.
renewal.failed: The licence could not be loaded.

export.title: Export all data
export.hint: Everything of this customer in one ZIP: every table in Excel, a SQL script that restores it, and the original photos, thermograms and spectra. It always works, also with the subscription lapsed. Passwords do not travel.
export.preparing: Preparing the export… it may take a few minutes.
export.downloadFailed: The export could not be downloaded.
